format: Internal preparation document, not an official API payload
title: SUNSET — Fund a beginning. Keep the commons open.
short_description: Pool capped sponsorship to release a verified offline learning resource, or claim a refund. Transfer a stewardship NFT to hand over recovery-mirror maintenance without restricting public access or changing who receives the funds.
problem: Shared resources can remain dependent on their original operator even after funding. Communities need an inspectable release agreement and a way to maintain discovery after hosting changes.
demonstration: Play the free sample without an account or wallet.
Complete capped sponsorship and inspect surplus change.
Publish a retained key; creator credit and public release occur together.
Recover the exact pack from independent files and export its standalone game.
Transfer the maintenance NFT; demonstrate former-owner mirror denial and unchanged public access/payment terms.
Verify a replacement mirror against the original manifest/ciphertext/key/plaintext commitments.
Show both funding-expiry and missed-release refunds, plus safe withdrawal state.
evidence_status: Local application, Rust and compiled-Wasm host checks only; protocol, browser and live settlement evidence remains outstanding.
differentiation_limits: Public buyouts, offline education and transferable maintenance authority have prior art. The prototype integrates verifiable release/refund, independent reuse and standard maintenance-token transfer. Demand and educational impact are not validated.
submission_gates: Verify the final official rules and candidate-track behavior.
Run real browser/mobile and network-disabled standalone HTML checks.
Run protocol-appropriate NEAR Sandbox gas/balance/receipt and receiver/callback failure checks.
Record actual reviewed testnet deployment and independent signer outcomes.
Obtain original content rights/educator review and adult sponsor feedback.
Publish real repository/demo with accurate team/payout details and explicit final submission approval.
